2014_spells.psychic-scream.description: You unleash the worst secrets of up to ten creatures of your choice. Only creatures that understand a language are affected. Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned.
2014_spells.psychic-scream.effectSummary: Deal 14d6 psychic damage to a target within 90 ft
2014_spells.psychic-scream.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, you unleash the worst secrets of up to ten creatures of your choice. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned; Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
